items.original_question: Return CR density (CRs per section) by spec (change-hotspot metric).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (hub:Spec)<-[:MODIFIES]-(cr:CR) WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL WITH hub, count(cr) AS crCnt MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub) WITH hub, crCnt, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC WITH hub, crCnt, collect(rk)[0] AS latestRk MATCH (latestRk)<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section) WITH hub, crCnt, count(s) AS secCnt RETURN hub.specNumber AS specNumber, crCnt, secCnt, round(1.0 * crCnt / secCnt, 2) AS density ORDER BY density DESC LIMIT 5
items.task_question: Within the recorded RAN2 graph, for every Spec hub whose specRelease is absent and which has at least one incoming CR MODIFIES link, count its distinct modifying CR nodes as crCnt. Choose its release-specific Spec node with the highest numeric Rel-N; break any equal release by id ascending. Count distinct Section nodes belonging to that release node as secCnt. items.reference_query: MATCH (hub:Spec)<-[:MODIFIES]-(cr:CR) WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL WITH hub,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub) WITH hub,crCnt,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC,rk.id ASC WITH hub,crCnt,collect(rk)[0] AS latestRk MATCH (latestRk)<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section) WITH hub,crCnt,count(DISTINCT s) AS secCnt WHERE secCnt>0 RETURN hub.specNumber AS specNumber,crCnt,secCnt,round(1.0*crCnt/secCnt,2) AS density
